Then, it should launch AEDT in a specified version and solution type, and set some properties such as material override, automatically use causal materials, open region, model units, and initial mesh. 

Next, the code should define variables for the flex cable CPWG, including total length, theta, radius, width, height, spacing, ground width, and ground thickness. It should also define a function to create a bending based on the curvature radius and extension.

The code should then draw a signal line and a ground line to create a bent signal wire and two bent ground wires respectively. It should also draw a dielectric to create a dielectric cable, and create bottom metals. 

Afterwards, the code should create port interfaces (PEC enclosures) and a Perfect E boundary condition. It should also create ports and a setup and sweep with specified properties. 

Finally, the code should plot the model and release AEDT.

```python
import pyaedt
from pyaedt import Hfss
from pyaedt.modeler.geometry_operators import GeometryOperators
from pyaedt.generic.constants import unit_converter
import math

# Set non-graphical mode
pyaedt.settings.non_graphical = True

# Launch AEDT
aedt_version = "2023.2"
project_name = "Flex_CPWG"
design_name = "CPWG_Flex"
solution_type = "DrivenModal"

hfss = Hfss(projectname=project_name, designname=design_name, specified_version=aedt_version, solution_type=solution_type)

# Set properties
hfss.materials.material_override = True
hfss.materials.automatic_use_causal_materials = True
hfss.modeler.create_open_region(Frequency="10GHz")
hfss.model_units = "mm"
hfss.mesh.assign_initial_mesh()

# Define CPWG variables
total_length = 100  # mm
theta = 45  # degrees, bending angle
radius = 30  # mm, bending radius
width = 2  # mm, signal width
height = 0.035  # mm, signal thickness
spacing = 0.3  # mm, gap between signal and ground
ground_width = 4  # mm, ground width
ground_thickness = 0.035  # mm, ground thickness
dielectric_height = 0.2  # mm
dielectric_material = "Polyimide"

# Helper function to create a bent path
def create_bent_path(start, direction, length, theta_deg, radius):
    theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)
    arc_length = radius * theta_rad
    straight_length = length - arc_length
    # First straight segment
    p1 = start
    p2 = [p1[0] + straight_length * direction[0], p1[1] + straight_length * direction[1], p1[2]]
    # Arc segment
    center = [p2[0], p2[1] + radius, p2[2]]
    arc_start = p2
    arc_end = [
        center[0] + radius * math.sin(theta_rad),
        center[1] - radius * (1 - math.cos(theta_rad)),
        p2[2]
    ]
    return [p1, p2, arc_end], center, theta_rad

# Draw signal line
start_point = [0, 0, dielectric_height + height / 2]
direction = [1, 0]
signal_path, arc_center, arc_theta = create_bent_path(start_point, direction, total_length, theta, radius)
signal_polyline = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(signal_path, xsection_type="Rectangle", xsection_width=width, xsection_height=height, name="Signal")

# Draw ground lines (left and right)
ground_offset = width / 2 + spacing + ground_width / 2
ground1_start = [start_point[0], start_point[1] + ground_offset, start_point[2]]
ground2_start = [start_point[0], start_point[1] - ground_offset, start_point[2]]
ground1_path, _, _ = create_bent_path(ground1_start, direction, total_length, theta, radius)
ground2_path, _, _ = create_bent_path(ground2_start, direction, total_length, theta, radius)
ground1_polyline = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(ground1_path, xsection_type="Rectangle", xsection_width=ground_width, xsection_height=ground_thickness, name="GND1")
ground2_polyline = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(ground2_path, xsection_type="Rectangle", xsection_width=ground_width, xsection_height=ground_thickness, name="GND2")

# Draw dielectric
dielectric_length = total_length + 2  # extra for enclosure
dielectric_width = 2 * (ground_offset + ground_width / 2) + 1
dielectric_box = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0] - 1, start_point[1] - dielectric_width / 2, 0],
    [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, dielectric_height],
    name="Dielectric",
    matname=dielectric_material
)

# Draw bottom metals (signal and grounds)
bottom_z = 0
bottom_signal = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0], start_point[1] - width / 2, bottom_z],
    [total_length, width, ground_thickness],
    name="BottomSignal"
)
bottom_gnd1 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0], start_point[1] + ground_offset - ground_width / 2, bottom_z],
    [total_length, ground_width, ground_thickness],
    name="BottomGND1"
)
bottom_gnd2 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0], start_point[1] - ground_offset - ground_width / 2, bottom_z],
    [total_length, ground_width, ground_thickness],
    name="BottomGND2"
)

# Create port interfaces (PEC enclosures)
pec_material = "pec"
enclosure_thickness = 1
enclosure1 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0] - enclosure_thickness, start_point[1] - dielectric_width / 2 - enclosure_thickness, 0],
    [enclosure_thickness, dielectric_width + 2 * enclosure_thickness, dielectric_height + height + enclosure_thickness],
    name="Enclosure1",
    matname=pec_material
)
enclosure2 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [start_point[0] + total_length, start_point[1] - dielectric_width / 2 - enclosure_thickness, 0],
    [enclosure_thickness, dielectric_width + 2 * enclosure_thickness, dielectric_height + height + enclosure_thickness],
    name="Enclosure2",
    matname=pec_material
)

# Assign Perfect E boundary to enclosures
hfss.assign_perfecte_to_sheets([enclosure1.faces[0], enclosure2.faces[1]])

# Create wave ports
port1 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_face(enclosure1.faces[4], 1)
port2 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_face(enclosure2.faces[5], 2)

# Create setup and sweep
setup = hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.props["PortsOnly"] = False
setup.update()
hfss.create_linear_count_sweep(setupname="Setup1", unit="GHz", freqstart=1, freqstop=20, num_of_freq_points=201, sweep_type="Interpolating")

# Plot model
hfss.plot(show=True)

# Release AEDT
hfss.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
